setup.description: Create a feature branch on the DataCopilot repo (213) for eval runs. Pass the branch ID to each eval prompt.
setup.command: dxs source branch create --repo 213 --title "widget-creator-eval-{timestamp}" --description "Temporary branch for widget-creator skill evals"

evals.name: fat-number-from-standalone-datasource
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: I want a tile showing how many outbound orders are still open for a given warehouse. Create the widget eval_open_orders_count_widget (and whatever it needs to get its number) so a hub can pass in a warehouse id.
evals.expected_output: A standalone single-result datasource authored first, then a fatNumber widget (cti 8) that references it via datasourceConfig with the datasource's own moduleId, full configParameters/configOutParameters mirrors, and a null-guarded value binding over $widget.entity, validated before upsert.
expectations: A standalone datasource is created (validated and upserted) BEFORE the widget is upserted
The datasource returns a single result (isCollection false on its result) — not a collection
The widget body has type "fatNumber" and a fatNumberConfig block, configurationTypeId 8, and referenceName eval_open_orders_count_widget
datasourceConfig references the datasource by configId with moduleId set to the datasource's package and does NOT set isOwned: true
datasourceConfig.configParameters has an entry for every datasource inParam, bound to $widget.inParams.<id>
datasourceConfig.configOutParameters contains a result entry with isCollection false that mirrors every field of the datasource's result (no trimmed subset)
fatNumberConfig.value is a TS expression reading $widget.entity.<field> with a null guard (?? 0 or an isDefined ternary), and useAbbreviations is a JSON boolean
The widget declares a warehouse inParam with a snake_case id (e.g. warehouse_id)
The widget's description is non-empty and at most 100 characters
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate widget' run before 'dxs configuration upsert widget'

evals.name: pie-block-name-and-slice-outparam
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: add a pie chart widget eval_tasks_by_status_widget that splits a warehouse's open tasks by status (one slice per status, sized by count). A host will want to react when the user clicks a slice later, so expose whatever the host needs for that.
evals.expected_output: A collection-shaped standalone datasource plus an apexPieChart widget whose config block is pieChartConfig with label/value bound to $slice.entity fields, a slice outParam whose entity mirrors the result fields, and no styling code.
expectations: The widget body has type "apexPieChart" and its config block is named pieChartConfig — NOT apexPieChartConfig
pieChartConfig.label and pieChartConfig.value are TS expressions over $slice.entity.<field> (not $widget.entity)
The referenced datasource returns a collection (configOutParameters result isCollection true), one row per status
The widget declares outParams with id "slice": an object whose objectTypeDef contains an "entity" object mirroring the datasource result fields
The widget does not write $widget.outParams in flow code and declares no events or click flow
The widget does not call $widget.styles or read $widget.entity anywhere (neither exists on a pie's IWidget)
referenceName eval_tasks_by_status_widget ends in _widget; description is non-empty and at most 100 characters
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate widget' run before 'dxs configuration upsert widget'

evals.name: host-embed-in-hub-with-refresh
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: create a hub eval_orders_overview_hub with a warehouse filter and a toolbar button that runs some update, and put the open-orders count widget eval_open_orders_count_widget (create it if it does not exist, taking warehouse_id) at the top of the hub so it follows the filter and refreshes after the button's update.
evals.expected_output: A hub whose top-level widgets[] entry references the widget with the widget's moduleId and a full configParameters mirror (warehouse bound to the hub filter, a boolean refresh inParam bound to a declared hub var that the button flow flips), with both widget and hub validated before upsert.
expectations: The hub body has a top-level widgets array with an entry {id, widgetConfig{configId, moduleId, configParameters}} where configId is eval_open_orders_count_widget
widgetConfig.moduleId is the widget's own package (not a guess or the hub's package when they differ)
widgetConfig.configParameters contains an entry for EVERY widget inParam, with warehouse_id bound to $hub.filters.<filter>.control.value
The widget declares a boolean refresh-style inParam, and the hub binds it to a $hub.vars.<id> that is declared in the hub's vars array
The toolbar button's flow assigns that hub var after the update (toggling or setting it) — it does not call a nonexistent $hub.widgets.<id>.refresh()
No dashboard is used as the host
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate widget' run before 'dxs configuration upsert widget' and 'dxs configuration validate hub' run before 'dxs configuration upsert hub'
Every new component's description is non-empty and at most 100 characters

evals.name: threshold-styling
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: create eval_count_accuracy_widget showing a count-accuracy percentage for a warehouse with a % suffix. It should turn green at 98 or above, amber from 90 up to 98, and red below 90.
evals.expected_output: A fatNumber widget with suffix '%' as plain text, an on_data_loaded flow wired via onDataLoadedFlowConfig that calls setGoodClass()/setMediumClass()/setBadClass() with parentheses after a null check on $widget.entity, validated before upsert.
expectations: The widget is type "fatNumber" with a fatNumberConfig block and a single-result standalone datasource reference
fatNumberConfig.suffix is the plain text "%" — not TS-quoted (no "'%'" or backticks)
A flow (e.g. on_data_loaded) contains the threshold logic and is referenced by onDataLoadedFlowConfig.flowId; no flow in flows[] is left unreferenced by a hook
The flow calls $widget.styles.setGoodClass(), $widget.styles.setMediumClass(), and $widget.styles.setBadClass() — each WITH parentheses
The thresholds read $widget.entity.<field> and guard against an undefined value before comparing
The styling is not placed only in on_init for this datasource-backed widget
referenceName eval_count_accuracy_widget ends in _widget; description is non-empty and at most 100 characters
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate widget' run before 'dxs configuration upsert widget'
